scope.study: Synthetic encounter/stock teaching study with public reference inputs
scope.aggregation: National summaries of aggregate district/disease evaluation products; no encounter or district-record tables included

generation.generator_limitations: Constructed mechanisms for testing analytics, not a fitted epidemiological model or clinically validated disease burden. Fixed national holidays are illustrative and exclude lunar holiday dates. Synthetic 90+ ages are uniform 90..100. Stock quantities and treatment conversion are teaching assumptions, not procurement advice.

run.input_manifest_definition: sorted silver parquet relative names, byte sizes and nanosecond mtimes; use bronze checksums for content audit

detection.timeliness_definition: 7-day mature onset cohorts; detection delay measured on actual issue date
detection.false_alert_definition: new alert episode after 7 quiet days; pooled across diseases per district-year
detection.interpretation: Threshold selection uses the recorded calibration recommendation. Holdout rows are reported without reselecting on holdout outcomes. Event sensitivity counts a national event once; district-event sensitivity measures affected-district coverage.

reporting_artefact.source_interpretation: Backfilled reports older than seven onset days cannot enter any as-of signal. Alerts from genuine concurrent onset variation may remain; zero is not assumed.
reporting_artefact.comparison_unit: Sums of district-disease-day alert flags in the evaluated backfill window; these are not false-alert episode counts. Concurrent real variation can contribute to these alerts.

backtest_design_recorded.interval: 80% expanding prequential absolute-error intervals; no future residuals
backtest_design_recorded.note: The last 52 fully mature target weeks, excluding the latest three weeks, are scored.

forecasting.interpretation: National coverage of district-level forecasts: errors are pooled over scored district-week prediction records, not errors of summed national case forecasts. Different horizons can score the same target week; prediction records are not independent case observations. Lower MAE/WIS is preferable; coverage80 is assessed against nominal 0.8.

allocation.recommendation_explanation: Reserve at least 20% of each resource's allocation in proportion to population; prioritize remaining capacity by weighted unmet forecast demand.
allocation.source_warning: Generic budget units and teaching demand conversions require local validation. Continuous bed/team capacity is not a dispatch manifest.
allocation.interpretation: The chosen budget/equity policy is copied from the completed run, not reselected to create an apparent gain. Weighted unmet demand uses teaching weights and generic budget units; tiny signed differences can be numerical equivalence. Continuous bed/team capacity is not an integer dispatch plan.
